meetings_digest.title: MedStation <> Dashboard
key_points: Dashboard: Nearly matches reporting needs; finance, KPI, and data definitions still need alignment.

key_points: Delivery Speed: Main build is largely complete; onboarding, access delays, and handoffs remain the biggest launch blockers.
Onboarding: Create one central client record and a 15-minute intake questionnaire before onboarding calls.
Med Station: Ads were ready for two weeks but inactive; Google Business Profile category remains an easy improvement.

meetings_digest.title: Medstation GHL Ramp up
key_points: Rollout Goal: Move all five active Medstation clinics onto GHL before year-end; inactive clinics excluded.
Build Plan: Clone Weston’s setup, starting with lower-volume clinics, then higher-volume clinics.
Timeline Risk: Build target is December 18–24; training starts early January, possibly extending to mid-January.
Technical Work: Create clinic-specific WhatsApp numbers, tracking, dashboards, integrations, pipelines, and workflows.
Lead Recovery: Enable 45-day reactivation and build follow-up for 98 interested leads who never booked.

meetings_digest.title: Web/SEO team coordination
key_points: Faster launches: Target client launches within 12–13 days using minor edits, lead magnets, CTAs, forms, GHL, and ads.
Unified onboarding: Combine SEO, web, CRM, and ads details into one form; store call links, access, and client data centrally.
Client records: Maintain one editable master sheet, plus linked strategy briefs covering locations, services, and priorities.
Commercial focus: Shift emphasis toward trade services; retain clients long-term, potentially accepting lower pricing for two-to-four-year relationships.
Location pricing: First three locations stay within base pricing; additional locations may cost $100–$300 each.
